/-- Arbitrary fixed wiring transports the bank and preserves the caller's heads. -/
theorem embed_bank_project {L J : Type*} (b : FinitePortBinding T U) (labels : L → J)
    (pc : L) (inner : T → FixedTapeCompiler.CopyMachine.Tape Bool)
    (outer : U → FixedTapeCompiler.CopyMachine.Tape Bool) (pos : U → ℤ) :
    MicrocodeEmbedding.embed b.ports labels
      (⟨⟨pc,fun t => (inner t).denote⟩,fun t => pos (b.ports t)⟩ : NativeMicrocode.Config T L)
      ⟨fun u => (outer u).denote,pos⟩ =
      ⟨⟨labels pc,fun u => (b.values inner outer u).denote⟩,pos⟩ := by
  simp only [MicrocodeEmbedding.embed,← values_eq_extend,map_values,values_project]

semantic_review.generic_lemma: Definitionally unfolds the same MicrocodeEmbedding.embed, uses the existing values_eq_extend and map_values for tape denotation, and values_project for absolute head positions. The port embedding and label map are unchanged.
semantic_review.machine_and_cost_definitions: All old nonproof source, including every machine, program, configuration, trace, state count, runtime budget and binding definition, is byte-for-byte preserved; only four imports are added.
semantic_review.scope: Conservative direct-bank/project batch only. Earlier expanded proposal involving bespoke lifted banks was excluded and is not approved by this review.
semantic_review.trust: New proof uses existing equalities and ordinary simp only. No axioms, sorry, unsafe code, native_decide, options, macros, or elaborators added.
semantic_review.caveat: No Lean/Lake execution by reviewer. Higher-order inference and reduction of source cfg definitions still require root compilation.
